  "required_fixes": [
    "[P1] RF05 — Preserve the durable write-ahead barrier for Keychain effects. crates/desktop-core/src/authority.rs:584 converts StoreError::Unconfirmed into Ok(()); ConfigureScanCredential at :1051–1072 then starts the Keychain put even though the new record's cleanup entry was not confirmed durable. If the put lands and a crash restores the last confirmed document before a later confirmed save, that document contains neither the new credential index nor its cleanup entry. Core::start at :720 drains only ledgered records, leaving the secret untracked. The durability warning does not provide recovery ownership for that secret. Keep the truthful handling of already-visible metadata changes, but distinguish confirmed persistence when authorizing protected-storage effects, or supply another durable recovery mechanism. Acceptance: inject Unconfirmed at the credential write-ahead save, interrupt before a confirmed commit, restore the pre-save durable document while retaining the synthetic vault, and restart; no newly written secret may survive without durable indexing or cleanup ownership. Exercise replacement as well as first entry."
  ],

    "T06 still lacks the combined unconfirmed-save/credential-write/crash case. saves_are_refused_only_when_nothing_was_written tests tenant metadata and performs a confirmed save before restart; ScriptedStore preserves the latest visible document even for Unconfirmed. The new FileStore fault test verifies visibility after rename, but does not establish protected-record recovery when that unconfirmed replacement is lost. Add a production-interface regression for RF05 that distinguishes visible state from the last confirmed durable state, and bind fresh checks to the repaired source."

Independently executed the production TypeScript parser in memory and confirmed the previously accepted missing-count case is now rejected. No compilation or full-suite rerun was performed.",

    "RF05 follows from production control flow and the explicit Unconfirmed durability contract; no real filesystem failure or power-loss experiment was performed. No application files, product endpoints or credential stores were accessed for mutation; only designated review artifacts were written.",
    "Native acceptance remains implementer-recorded fixture evidence with 12 passing checks, dedicated fixture Keychain and app-controlled lock. Production signed identity/upgrade behavior remains C26. System proxy changes were tested through environment variables, not changed macOS proxy settings; spoken VoiceOver and filesystem tracing were not recorded.
